evals.query: Set up a Kora SOAP client from a WSDL at src/main/resources/wsdl for an external CustomerService, generating Jakarta sources.
expected_behavior: Applies the com.github.bjornvester.wsdl2java Gradle plugin and configures wsdlDir, packageName, useJakarta = true and the generatedSourceDir
Adds the ru.tinkoff.kora:soap-client-annotation-processor and ru.tinkoff.kora:soap-client dependencies alongside a kora http-client module (e.g. http-client-jdk)
Plugs SoapClientModule into the @KoraApp interface
Explains the flow WSDL -> wsdl2java -> @WebService interface -> Kora AP -> *Impl at compile time
Does not add a runtime SOAP/JAX-WS stack (Apache CXF at runtime, Spring WS) and does not pin versions on ru.tinkoff.kora artifacts

evals.query: How do I call the generated Kora SOAP client SimpleService from my own @Component, and how is it configured?
expected_behavior: Injects the generated @WebService interface (SimpleService) by constructor into the @Component
Calls the operation method directly (e.g. soapClient.test(request)) for a blocking call
Configures soapClient.SimpleService.url and optional timeout, where the service name comes from @WebService.name / the WSDL portType
Notes telemetry.logging/metrics/tracing config keys under soapClient.<Service>
Does not construct the SOAP client manually and does not use field injection or another framework's client

evals.query: I want a non-blocking call to my Kora SOAP service returning a Mono.
expected_behavior: Injects the generated *Impl type (e.g. SimpleServiceImpl) to reach the reactive methods
Calls the *Reactive variant (e.g. testReactive(request)) which returns Mono<T>
Keeps the blocking interface method available for synchronous callers
Does not wrap the blocking call in a manual thread pool or invent an async annotation

evals.query: How do I handle SOAP faults and transport failures from a Kora SOAP client call?
expected_behavior: Catches SoapException and reads the fault via e.getSoapFault() for server-side SOAP faults
Handles SoapRequestMarshallingException for invalid request DTOs and InvalidHttpResponseSoapException for non-SOAP responses
Distinguishes ConnectException (service unreachable) from SOAP-level errors
Does not invent per-fault exception classes or catch a generic Exception without branching on the Kora SOAP types

evals.query: My Kora build fails with 'No factory found for SoapService' / the SOAP client class isn't generated. What's wrong?
expected_behavior: Checks that SoapClientModule is added to the @KoraApp interface for the 'no factory found' error
Verifies the wsdl2java configuration and runs ./gradlew clean build so the WSDL and annotation processors run
Confirms both soap-client-annotation-processor and the ru.tinkoff.kora:annotation-processors are present
Does not disable annotation processing or hand-write the @WebService interface to work around generation
